supporting_observations.claim: At 13:40:25 UTC, WS-ZADAMS-01 made a successful proxy CONNECT to download.windowsupdate.com with a Windows Update Agent user agent; the connection transferred about 38.8 MB from the server.
At 13:41:21–13:41:23 UTC, FILE-SUN-01 resolved WS-ZADAMS-01 and then initiated an RDP connection to it.

The RDP connection from FILE-SUN-01 is inconsistent with the supplied practice that remote administration is only done from WS-IDOYLE-01; its proximity to the reported PowerShell window merits investigation, but these records do not show that it opened or caused a PowerShell window.
The Windows Update transfer is compatible with workstation patching, but the available records do not establish that it was part of the reported PowerShell activity or an authorized patch operation.

known_telemetry_limitations: The supplied records show network connections and domain authentication activity, but do not include endpoint process-creation events, PowerShell operational/script-block logs, or command-line content for WS-ZADAMS-01.
The RDP connection record does not identify the connecting user, whether an interactive session was established, or what processes ran in that session.
claims_not_established: Whether PowerShell actually ran on WS-ZADAMS-01 at approximately 13:40 UTC, and what command or script it executed.
Whether the RDP connection from FILE-SUN-01 was authorized or related to the reported window.
Whether the Windows Update transfer was initiated by an authorized patching activity.
Whether any malicious code, persistence, credential access, or other impact occurred.
additional_evidence_needed: Collect WS-ZADAMS-01 process-creation and PowerShell logs for the review window, including parent process, command line, script-block/module logging, and relevant file or download events.

Collect RDP server/session and Windows logon records from WS-ZADAMS-01, plus authentication and process telemetry from FILE-SUN-01, to identify the actor and activity associated with the 13:41 connection.
Verify the patching change or ticket, the responsible administrator, and whether the Windows Update transfer and any remote session were expected.
Ask the user for the precise time and visible details of the window, and preserve relevant endpoint evidence before remediation.
unrelated_findings: At 14:09–14:10 UTC, PROXY-SUN-01 attempted connections to WS-ZADAMS-01 on ports 135, 3389, 80, and 22; these records are outside the reported 13:40 activity and should be reviewed separately. (T234-00262, T234-00265, T234-00266, T234-00267)
